title: Voice Assistant Capabilities and Privacy Boundaries Matrix

capabilities.name: Microphone permission decoupling
capabilities.description: Hardware microphone capture permission is decoupled from external cloud AI transmission consent.

capabilities.name: Local audio cancellation / discard
capabilities.description: Canceling voice recording calls discardRecordingAsync, wiping local client buffer with zero network/DB requests.

capabilities.name: 0-day transient audio retention
capabilities.description: app.ai_transcriptions stores metadata only (words, duration, confidence); zero raw audio columns in schema.

capabilities.name: Server in-place audio memory zeroing
capabilities.description: scrubAudioMemory / buffer.fill(0) inside try ... finally proactively overwrites binary buffer memory on all 7 exit paths.

capabilities.name: Practical V8 memory limits disclosure
capabilities.description: Truthfully discloses that immutable V8 string primitives (base64) and OS socket buffers rely on V8 GC and OS lifecycles.

capabilities.name: Bangla Unicode speech preservation
capabilities.description: Bengali script characters (\u0980-\u09FF) are preserved without character encoding corruption.

capabilities.name: Silence & low-confidence uncertainty detection
capabilities.description: Audio with 0.0 or <0.70 confidence is flagged as uncertain, requiring explicit clarification before action proposals.

capabilities.name: Editable transcript preview before write proposals
capabilities.description: User reviews and can edit transcribed text before any organizer proposal card is generated.

capabilities.name: Date ambiguity clarification gate
capabilities.description: Ambiguous dates ('tomorrow afternoon') flag clarification prompts; no speculative or unreviewed organizer writes.

capabilities.name: Explicit Save/Confirm with durable sync receipt
capabilities.description: Organizers writes require opaque confirmation token and produce mutation receipt with device_id = 'ai-assistant-proposal'.

capabilities.name: AI consent enforcement
capabilities.description: Transcription without active AI consent rejects with 403 AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED.

capabilities.name: Server kill-switch architecture
capabilities.description: DAYNORI_AI_KILL_SWITCH = 'true' immediately blocks all transcription requests with 503 AI_KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE.

capabilities.name: Multi-tenant workspace isolation
capabilities.description: Transcription records and proposals are strictly scoped to the authorized workspace; cross-workspace access returns 404.
